name: 1688/item/description-images
description: Get the description images of a 1688 product listing by item ID, for catalog preparation and product research.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# 1688 Product Description Images API Returns the description images of a 1688 product listing, plus the raw description HTML. It needs one input: the 1688 product ID in `itemId`. ## Use cases - Download the description images of a listing to prepare catalog entries for a resale store. - Review the detail-page artwork of a competing product during product research. - Extract image URLs from the description HTML to check which images a listing embeds. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/1688/item/description-images" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"itemId": "857511694718"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `itemId` | string | Yes | 1688 product ID. | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "detail_html": "
` tags with `src` links to the description images, plus layout styles. | ## Notes - Send `itemId` as a string. The response returns `item_id` as a number. - Use `detail_imgs` when you only need image links. Parse `detail_html` when you also need the order of the images in the description. - For other data about the same listing, call [1688 Product Details](/apis/1688/item/detail) with the same ID. - If you only have a product link, use [1688 Product Details by URL](/apis/1688/item/detail-by-url). ## Pricing $0.014286 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization.
